_why: lane help-ai-chat, Do 4 — the help chat's QUALITY BAR. Each fixture is a question people ask (the article's own `asked:` lines in content/help/), the article that answers it, and a RECORDED answer: here the reference answer (the article's summary, citing it), authored, never generated. Per-candidate recorded answers (one file per model in tooling/ports/ai.json features.help.candidates) are recorded by the lead with the vault key and graded by the same test; the cheapest model whose answers all pass is set as features.help.model. No live model is called by this repository's tests.
